title: Running the Titan_ONT Workflow on Terra.bio
author: Francis J Ambrosio
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bzyip7ue

steps.title: Access the Titan_ONT Workflow
steps.instruction: Navigate to the Titan_ONT assembly workflow page within the Terra.bio workspace.

substeps.instruction: Click on the 'Workflows' panel in the workspace.

steps.title: Configure Workflow Version and Data Settings
steps.instruction: Set the workflow version and data selection parameters.

substeps.instruction: Select the latest stable version of the workflow (avoid 'main' or 'dev' versions).
Ensure 'Run workflow(s) with inputs defined by data table' is selected.
Select the root entity type for the data to be analyzed.
Optionally, check the 'Use call caching' box to skip previously run jobs and reduce compute costs.
Click 'SELECT DATA' and choose the samples for analysis.

steps.title: Complete the INPUTS Form
steps.instruction: Define the input variables by mapping them to the data table attributes or workspace elements.

substeps.instruction: For the 'demultiplex_reads' variable, enter 'this.reads' in the Attribute text box (or 'this.' followed by your specific reads column name).
For the primer_bed file, input the chosen file saved as a workspace element in Terra.
For the 'samplename' variable, enter 'this.ont_specimen_id' in the Attribute text box.

steps.title: Configure OUTPUTS and Save
steps.instruction: Set the output parameters and save the configuration to enable analysis.

substeps.instruction: In the OUTPUTS form, select 'Use Defaults' to populate default output options.
Click the 'Save' button on the top right-hand side of the page.
Verify that yellow caution icons have disappeared and the 'Run Analysis' option is available.

steps.title: Launch the Analysis
steps.instruction: Execute the workflow and monitor the job progress.

substeps.instruction: Click the 'Run Analysis' button to the right of the 'Outputs' tab.
In the 'Confirm launch' popup window, click the 'Launch' button.
Navigate to the 'Job History' panel to monitor the status as it changes from queued to submitted to running.
